apps.name: Kodi
apps.author: Team Kodi (packaged by ATVHome)
apps.description: The media centre: your movies, shows and music from the network or a drive. Repackaged for the Apple TV 3 with ATVHome's fixes (full screen, remote, settings tuned for the A5). Installs as a system app (about 1–2 minutes).

apps.name: Moonlight
apps.author: ATV Revival (Moonlight: moonlight-stream.org, GPL-3)
apps.description: Stream games from a PC or Mac running Sunshine. Pairs with a PIN, smooth frame pacing, on-screen stats, PS5 controller or mouse and keyboard. 720p60 on the Apple TV 3, 720p30 on the Apple TV 2.

apps.name: Hello
apps.author: ATVKit
apps.description: The ATVKit sample app: a message, the on-screen keyboard and a video. Copy it to start your own.
